goals.objective: HEAVY delivery goal: implement and prove the webapp form-preview requirement. Criteria: C1 browser at localhost:4173 select F-008 and see its complete original content without truncation plus an enabled HWPX 작성 button; capture screenshot and DOM text in artifacts/qa/wp03-preview-full. C2 browser select a protected F-050 and verify the preview retains allowed common content while prohibited personal fields remain absent; capture screenshot and DOM assertions in artifacts/qa/wp03-preview-protected. C3 click HWPX 작성 for a completed F-008 form with non-identifying values and verify downloaded HWPX ZIP has no unresolved allowed tokens and original entries remain intact; capture parsed ZIP report in artifacts/qa/wp03-hwpx-export. C4 regression: npm run lint, npm run build, and PowerShell verify-phase static show no code/build failure; capture logs in artifacts/qa/wp03-regression. C5 browser accessibility/responsive QA at 320px and 1280px with keyboard focus and zero console errors; capture screenshots and console log in artifacts/qa/wp03-accessibility. Stop right away when all criteria pass on the final tree, runtime resources are torn down, independent code review and QA/gate review approve, and the project quality hook passes.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser: run webapp on localhost:4173, select F-008 in 서식함, click 미리보기, then inspect modal text and screenshot. PASS iff all source sections are rendered without ellipsis/summary truncation and HWPX 작성 is enabled for valid non-identifying common data.

Browser: select protected F-050 and open preview with allowed common values. PASS iff all available original non-personal form content renders, the HWPX action follows the completion policy, and prohibited name/contact/signature/survey-response controls and text are absent.

Run npm run lint, npm run build, PowerShell verify-phase static; then browser QA at 320px and 1280px: keyboard focus reaches modal controls, no console errors, and an F-008 HWPX export ZIP has no unresolved allowed tokens with unchanged non-XML entries. PASS iff commands exit 0 and browser/ZIP assertions hold.

goals.title: 웹앱 입력 UX·직접 인쇄·설치형·정적 배포
goals.objective: 사업정보 구매학년 1~6, 계약방식 콤보(1인수의/2인견적/2단계계약/입찰계약), 제출·납품기한 날짜 선택, 각 서식의 즉시 인쇄를 구현한다. npm 없이 실행 가능한 Windows 설치형 패키지와 서버·DB 없는 정적 웹 배포 경로를 구현·문서화하고 실제 앱 QA·코드리뷰·품질 검증으로 입증한다.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser: 사업정보에서 구매학년 1~6 콤보, 계약방식 4개 콤보, 제출·납품기한 date picker를 선택하고 F-008 미리보기에서 바로 인쇄를 실행한다. PASS iff 저장값과 화면 상태가 일치하고 미리보기 원문 전체만 인쇄 대화상자로 전달된다.
Browser: F-050 보호 서식과 HWPX loading/error 및 invalid input에서 출력 동작을 시도한다. PASS iff 개인정보는 빈 양식으로만 유지되고, 불완전/오류 문서는 PDF·바로인쇄가 차단된다.

Build Electron NSIS installer and static site artifact. PASS iff installer launches offline without npm/Node, static build has no Functions/DB/API, and lint/build/quality checks pass; production static deploy is not performed without explicit user approval.

goals.evidence: 2026-09-25 사용자 요청 1~7: 입력 UX, EXE 설치, 지속 실행, 정적 호스팅, 서식 인쇄.
